data.alarmCause: The server has not received the network connection request from the device.
data.repairSuggestion: 1. Check whether the device is powered on and running properly. 2. Check the network between the device and the management system.

data.repairSuggestion: 1. If any DC SWITCH is OFF, do not turn on the AC or DC switch. Contact your vendor or technical support.
Check whether the PV string is reversely connected.
